unit.why: A single narrative: R. Zusha, wandering incognito, meets the ten-year-old Jacob Isaac of Lublin, whose long weeping leads Zusha to grant him nefesh and ruach and send him to R. Elimelekh.

stories.start_quote: בעת שהי׳ הה״ק רבי ר׳ אישא ז"ל ונד
stories.end_quote: ומאז נעשה תלמיד הקדוש רבי אלימלך ז״ל
stories.summary_en: While R. Zusha wandered unrecognized, he prayed behind the stove in the town of the boy Jacob Isaac (the future Seer of Lublin); after one look from Zusha the boy wept for hours until blood came, and Zusha told him he had given him nefesh and ruach and sent him to his brother Elimelekh, of whom the boy became a disciple.
